alarm_query: ask which alarms i have set or when the next one goes off
alarm_remove: turn off, cancel, or delete an alarm i already set
alarm_set: set an alarm or wake-up call to go off at a certain time
audio_volume_down: turn the volume down a bit or make the sound quieter
audio_volume_mute: mute the sound, go silent, or stop playing for a while
audio_volume_other: open the volume settings or change the volume without saying up or down
audio_volume_up: turn the volume up, make the sound louder, or unmute it
calendar_query: ask about my upcoming meetings, events, or pending reminders on my schedule
calendar_remove: delete or cancel a meeting, event, or reminder on my calendar
calendar_set: add a meeting or event to my calendar, or ask you to remind me of something
cooking_query: ask a general cooking question, like what to cook or an ingredient swap
cooking_recipe: ask for a recipe or how to cook a dish, including time and temperature
datetime_convert: convert a given time to another place, ask the hour gap between two places, or switch my clock's zone
datetime_query: ask what time or date it is now, here or in another city or time zone
email_addcontact: save a new email address or contact to my contact list
email_query: check my inbox or ask about emails i have received
email_querycontact: look up a contact's phone number, email, address, or birthday
email_sendemail: write and send an email to someone or reply to one
general_greet: say hello or ask how you are doing
general_joke: ask you for a joke or something funny
general_quirky: chat, share my feelings, ask your opinion, or ask something odd that fits nothing else
iot_cleaning: start or schedule the robot vacuum to clean the house
iot_coffee: have the coffee machine make me a cup of coffee
iot_hue_lightchange: change the light color or mood, or set the lights to an exact level
iot_hue_lightdim: dim the lights or make the room less bright
iot_hue_lightoff: switch the lights off in a room or the whole house
iot_hue_lighton: switch the lights on, or complain it is too dark to see
iot_hue_lightup: brighten lights that are already on or make the room brighter
iot_wemo_off: turn off the wemo smart plug socket or the device plugged into it
iot_wemo_on: turn on the wemo smart plug socket or the device plugged into it
lists_createoradd: create a new list or add an item to one of my lists
lists_query: ask what lists i have or what items are on a list
lists_remove: delete a whole list or remove an item from a list
music_dislikeness: say i dislike the song playing so you stop playing it
music_likeness: say i like a song, artist, or genre, or save a song as a favorite
music_query: ask about a song, artist, album, or my music collection without playing it
music_settings: turn shuffle or repeat on or off, or skip the current song
news_query: ask for the latest news or headlines on a topic or from an outlet
play_audiobook: play or resume an audiobook or book from where i left off
play_game: start a game or play a game with you
play_music: start playing a song, artist, genre, album, or playlist
play_podcasts: play a podcast or go to its next episode
play_radio: turn on the radio or tune to a station, channel, or radio show
qa_currency: ask an exchange rate or convert an amount between currencies
qa_definition: ask what a word means or ask for a description of something
qa_factoid: ask a fact about the world, like a person, place, date, count, or unit
qa_maths: ask you to calculate a sum, square root, equation, or math formula
qa_stock: ask a company's stock price or how its shares are doing
recommendation_events: find public events, concerts, or shows to go to in a city or area
recommendation_locations: find a good restaurant, shop, hotel, or other place nearby
recommendation_movies: ask for a movie to watch, or which movies are showing and when
social_post: post or update my status on social media, or tweet a complaint to a company
social_query: check what's new on my social media feed, posts, or notifications
takeaway_order: place an order for food from a restaurant, for delivery or take-out
takeaway_query: ask whether a restaurant does delivery or take-out, or check on my food order
transport_query: ask train times or directions for getting somewhere
transport_taxi: book a taxi or uber ride
transport_ticket: book or buy a train, plane, or bus ticket
transport_traffic: ask about traffic or road conditions on my way
weather_query: ask about the weather or forecast, or what to wear for it
